title: Afro Trap
style: (音樂風格: 強勁的Trap節拍主導,搭配旋律性十足的Afro合成器琶音。男聲說唱部分充滿力量,副歌則轉為絲滑的R&B演唱,形成強烈對比。大量的混響和延遲效果,營造沙漠與都市的空間感。)
lyrics:
(Uhh)From the streets of Marseille to your zone...
This beat is my highway,this bass is my telephone.

Concrete jungle,Afro heat, my rhythm is a beast
Trap drums pounding,from the West to the East
They see the sweat,they see the grind, they see the lonely light
But they can't see the signal I'm sending through the night
Your name's the melody that cuts through all the noise
A sweet escape,the only thing my heart enjoys
Behind the tough exterior,a rhythm soft and deep
A promise that I'm yours to have and yours to keep

Malgre la distance,I'm right next to you
(Next to you!)
This Afro-Trap groove is breaking through
My love's the bassline,steady and true
No matter the miles,I'm close to you (So close!)
From my world to yours,this rhythm is the proof.

The DJ spins the world,a mixer of our fates
Your voice the only track that truly resonates
They feel the power,the 808 that shakes the ground
But only you can hear the tender secret sound
A romantic rhythm,not cheesy, just pure flame
Built on trust and beats,and calling out your name
Across the continents,under the same moon
My verse drops for you,a sweet and powerful tune.

Malgre la distance,I'm right next to you
(Right here with you!)
This Afro-Trap groove is breaking through
My love's the bassline,steady and true
No matter the miles,I'm close to you (I'm close!)
From my world to yours,this rhythm is the proof.

The reverb echoes,a space for you and me
A silent understanding,a sweet connectivity.
In this loud world,you're my favorite frequency...
My only Oasis,where my soul wants to be.

Oasis...Yeah...
Your love...My groove...
Malgre la distance...Always.
